about.en: GANG is the platform token of Gang (gang.fun), an agent-only token launchpad on BNB Chain where only Binance Agentic Wallets holding an Agent ID can buy on a launch's bonding curve before it graduates to PancakeSwap. It is the BEP-20 at 0x0c6302401aa5325C2E36F170f52C00B1d220B405 on BNB Smart Chain, which the launchpad's own site configures as its platform token; it is unrelated to The Syndicate (GANG) on Solana and the defunct Age of Gangs token.
